params.name: LModule
params.desc: if false all module definitions will be ignored. specifies the elements of a module.

params.name: Module(,)
params.desc: specifies the elements of a module.

params.name: Mod_Xoff( )
params.desc: transverse offset of a module in x.

params.name: Mod_Yoff( )
params.desc: transverse offset of a module in y.

params.name: Mod_Xrot( )
params.desc: rotation of a module in the x-z plane, i.e. around the y-axis.

params.name: Mod_Yrot( )
params.desc: rotation of a module in the y-z plane, i.e. around the x-axis.

params.name: Mod_Zrot( )
params.desc: rotation of a module in the x-y plane, i.e. around the z-axis.

params.name: Mod_Zpos( )
params.desc: longitudinal position of a module. Rotations are defined with respect to this position. Note, that Mod_zpos is not affected by a shift introduced with the parameter Mod_zoff

params.name: Mod_Efield( )
params.desc: scaling strength for electric field of a module.

params.name: Mod_phase( )
params.desc: phase offset of the RF fields of a module.

params.name: Mod_Bfield( )
params.desc: scaling strength for magnetic fields of a module.
